summary: Siuslaw NF lookout 23 miles NE of Florence, Oregon: 41-foot R-6 tower built 1959, last staffed 1972; gone, removal undated; the hill has been logged.

corrections.why: The register's 'Administered by' field is cut short at 'U.S. Forest'; the register and Rex's page place the site in the Siuslaw National Forest.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register, Rex's page and firelookout.com give 41 feet; the personal account says 40 feet. The 41-foot figure is used and matches the brief's 12.5 m.

The register gives 1,875 ft (571 m), which matches the brief's elevation_m 571.5; firelookout.com and the personal account give 1,785 ft. Elevation is left out of the story; the editor should decide which figure to show.

notes_for_editor: Source 4 is a first-person personal website; only site facts and the author's staffed seasons are used, the author is not named, and no personal details are carried into the story. The account dates its return visit to 1972 ('I had visited Divide in 1972'). The site's navigation menu lists a page titled 'Return to Divide Lookout on a Forest Service trail crew', but the account text does not say the 1972 visit was made with a trail crew, so the story does not say so. Removal year is not in any source; the status note says so. Brief agency 'U.S. Forest' is a truncated register value; correction proposed. Brief height_m 12.5 (41 ft) matches. Brief elevation_m 571.5 matches the register but firelookout.com gives 1,785 ft. Current access not found. Three photos are credited to the register and firelookout.com collections without URLs, so none were added.
